This '''individual''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who worked as a land agent on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vandor-3]].<ref name="MK" /> In [[44 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]'' to [[44 ABY]].</ref> [[Myri Antilles]], while working undercover in [[Jokko Haning's Emporium]], saw the land agent selling lush [[Color/Legends|green]] countryside properties inside the bar. She surmised that he probably enjoyed some success there through the sheer audacity of offering a product so very different from the others.<ref name="MK" />
